server.name.description: Human-readable name of the server, displayed to players.

server.bind_address.description: IP address the server will bind to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

server.port.description: TCP port the server listens on for incoming client connections.

logging.level.description: Verbosity of server logs; recommended levels: debug, info, warn, error.

logging.file.description: Path to the server log file.

world.max_players.description: Maximum number of concurrent players allowed on the server.

world.map_directory.description: Directory containing map files (.map) used by the server.

rules.turn_time.description: Time (in seconds) per player turn during combat or movement resolution.

pathfinder.enabled.description: Use pathfinding algorithms for NPC movement and routing.

pathfinder.verbose.description: Log detailed pathfinding decisions (useful for debugging).

auth.enabled.description: Require players to authenticate with credentials before connecting.

auth.timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait for authentication before disconnecting.

admins.description: List of administrative users with elevated privileges.

password_hash.description: Pre-hashed password (e.g., SHA256) — never store plaintext.

modules.description: List of loadable modules (e.g., quests, events, economy).

map_overrides.description: Per-map customizations that override global settings.

max_players.description: Maximum players on this map; if omitted, uses global 'world.max_players'.

turn_time.description: Turn time (seconds) for this map; if omitted, uses global 'rules.turn_time'.
